description: Retorna snapshot KB de framework regulatório setorial (10 frameworks Sprint 2026-05-27): BCB-LEI-14478 (BR VASP), EUDR (EU Deforestation), MIFID-II (EU securities), PCI-DSS (card data), CVM-RES-175 (BR security tokens), RFB-IN-1888 (BR crypto tax), EIDAS-2 (EU Digital Identity Wallet), FATF-TRAVEL-RULE (global AML), SEC-HOWEY-REG-D (US securities), CNBV-UIF-MEXICO (MX fintech+AML). Distinto de check_compliance (data protection jurisdictions). Use para entender requirements + on-chain automation opportunities por framework.

framework.description: Código do framework. 10 valores aceitos + aliases (PCI, CVM, RFB, EIDAS, EUDI, FATF, HOWEY, SEC, CNBV, BCB, EUDR, MIFID, etc.). Veja resolveSectoralFrameworkCode para lista completa de aliases.

includeFullArticles.description: Se true, retorna keyArticles completo (verbose). Default false (snapshot resumido).

name: check_sectoral_framework
